name: trust
description: Policy evaluator and package-integrity verifier. It never executes package code and never enforces a decision; callers must enforce the returned allow/deny.

tools.name: managed_policy
tools.description: Evaluate a managed policy. action=load returns the loaded policy and rule counts; action=check takes {tool,command,path} and returns allow|deny plus matched rules (deny wins; missing/invalid policy or missing default => deny); action=list returns a summary and the last 20 audit records. Reads GAMAI_POLICY (default ~/.config/gamai/trust/policy.json). This is an evaluator, not an enforcement point.

tool.description: tool name, e.g. shell or plugin__trust__managed_policy

command.description: shell command or action text to evaluate

tools.name: marketplace_verify
tools.description: Verify package integrity without executing it: SHA-256 for every file, a manifest (manifest.json|TRUST.json|trust.json) with a files map, and an Ed25519 signature. Without a pinned public key (argument or GAMAI_TRUST_PUBKEY), a valid self-signature is reported as self_signed and is not trusted. Detects missing, mismatched, unexpected and symlinked content.

public_key.description: pinned Ed25519 public key (PEM, 64 hex chars, or base64 raw 32-byte key); also GAMAI_TRUST_PUBKEY
